audit.why: TRICKY / 7.5/10 on 56.77% over 310 games. The packet flags the win rate as contradicting a Pantheon-heavy chart, but that is the real shape: he owns levels 1-5 and falls off, and Quinn's win rate comes from surviving that and reclaiming at two items. The page already argues exactly this.
audit.corrected: diff, diffRating, tone and carryRating left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Quinn, Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Quinn, Pantheon, Pantheon in both layers. The packet reads Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Pantheon, Quinn.
audit.why: Every why underneath already argued the packet version — whys[0] and whys[1] describe him bullying levels 1-2, whys[4] literally says level 6 goes 'genuinely even', and whys[6] says you reclaim it at two items. Four rows contradicted their own text, including the final row, which told the reader the late game belonged to Pantheon while the paragraph beneath it said the opposite.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits Pantheon with a passive that BLOCKS basic attacks — 'his passive blocks my Harrier autos', 'through his auto-block', 'his passive auto-block'. Mortal Will does no such thing. Two genuinely decisive interactions are missing instead.
audit.why: Riot text for Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' There is no damage block anywhere in it. Meanwhile: Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18s) makes him 'invulnerable to damage from the front' — a positional weakness — and it is flagged as a channel, so Vault's brief interrupt cancels it. Shield Vault (W, 13/12/11/10/9s, 600 range) is a point-click dash-stun and an auto reset, which means it cancels the Behind Enemy Lines channel.
audit.corrected: Every auto-block reference removed and replaced with Mortal Will's actual empower. Aegis Assault's front-only invulnerability written in, with Vault's interrupt as the counter. Shield Vault named as the channel killer with its range and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven whys and all three phase paragraphs are written in the FIRST PERSON — 'my poke', 'I have no kit', 'this is where I flip it'.
audit.why: The site's voice is second-person coaching; a first-person page reads as someone else's scrim notes.
audit.corrected: whys[0] through whys[6], early, mid and late rewritten in second person at matched length, fixing the ability names in the same pass.

notes: FABRICATED MECHANIC REMOVED: this page told the player six separate times that Pantheon's passive blocks basic attacks ('his passive blocks my Harrier autos', 'through his auto-block', 'his passive-block burst', 'his passive auto-block'). Mortal Will does nothing of the kind — it empowers his next spell. A Quinn player following that advice would avoid auto-trading for a reason that does not exist. Every instance is replaced. The two facts that DO decide the matchup and were absent — Aegis Assault being invulnerable from the front only, and Vault's interrupt cancelling that channel — are now in both layers.
